watch.title: Interstellar
watch.creator: Christopher Nolan
watch.note: Love transcends dimensions of time and space. The docking sequence with Hans Zimmer’s organ score remains unmatched in modern cinema.

watch.title: Blade Runner 2049
watch.creator: Denis Villeneuve
watch.note: Atmospheric visual poetry. Roger Deakins’ cinematography and Benjamin Wallfisch’s synth soundscapes create an overwhelming sensory triumph.

watch.title: Dune: Part Two
watch.creator: Denis Villeneuve
watch.note: A towering sci-fi epic. The visual scale of Arrakis and the tactile sound design make every frame feel biblical.

watch.title: Inception
watch.creator: Christopher Nolan
watch.note: A masterclass in parallel editing and high-concept architecture. The spinning totem and dream layers remain iconic.

watch.title: Drive
watch.creator: Nicolas Winding Refn
watch.note: Synthwave neon and quiet tension. Cliff Martinez’s soundtrack and the elevator sequence define cool restraint.

watch.title: Spider-Verse
watch.creator: Persichetti, Ramsey, Rothman
watch.note: Revolutionized western animation. Halftone dots, variable frame rates, and graffiti art colliding into pure joy.

watch.title: Oppenheimer
watch.creator: Christopher Nolan
watch.note: A relentless psychological thriller dressed as a historical biopic. The Trinity test sequence leaves you breathless.

watch.title: Arrival
watch.creator: Denis Villeneuve
watch.note: Language, nonlinear perception, and profound empathy. Max Richter’s 'On the Nature of Daylight' anchors the emotional core.

watch.title: Severance
watch.creator: Dan Erickson
watch.note: Brilliant corporate dystopian satire and mystery box storytelling. The Lumon office set design is pure sterile perfection.

watch.title: Succession
watch.creator: Jesse Armstrong
watch.note: Shakespearean tragedy disguised as dark comedy. Nicholas Britell’s piano score and blistering dialogue set a new standard.

watch.title: Dark
watch.creator: Baran bo Odar
watch.note: The most airtight time travel puzzle ever constructed. Every thread connects across three generations of Winden families.

watch.title: Arcane
watch.creator: Fortiche / Riot Games
watch.note: Hand-painted 2D/3D hybrid style that redefined animated storytelling. The emotional fracture between Vi and Jinx is devastating.

watch.title: Mindhunter
watch.creator: David Fincher
watch.note: Methodical procedural pacing, razor-sharp dialogue, and chilling interview scenes. Fincher’s obsessive craft in every shot.

watch.title: Mr. Robot
watch.creator: Sam Esmail
watch.note: Unconventional quadrant framing, authentic terminal hacking, and mental health exploration. Season 4 episode 7 is legendary.

watch.title: Chernobyl
watch.creator: Craig Mazin
watch.note: What is the cost of lies? Harrowing, claustrophobic atmosphere captured with Hildur Guðnadóttir’s metallic industrial sounds.

watch.title: The Bear
watch.creator: Christopher Storer
watch.note: High-wire anxiety and culinary craft. The intensity of a kitchen brigade paired with deeply moving family catharsis.

watch.title: Spirited Away
watch.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
watch.note: Pure cinematic magic. The train gliding over the flooded tracks and Joe Hisaishi’s piano theme evoke eternal nostalgia.

watch.title: Attack on Titan
watch.creator: Hajime Isayama
watch.note: Unmatched narrative foreshadowing and moral complexity. Hiroyuki Sawano’s bombastic orchestral score elevates every battle.

watch.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
watch.creator: Studio Trigger
watch.note: Vibrant neon ultra-violence with a devastating emotional punch. 'I Really Want to Stay at Your House' will never sound the same.

watch.title: Your Name
watch.creator: Makoto Shinkai
watch.note: Breathtaking twilight skies, comets, and missed connections. RADWIMPS’ music anchors Shinkai’s romantic peak.

watch.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
watch.creator: Sunghoo Park / MAPPA
watch.note: Fluid martial arts animation, kinetic hand-to-hand combat, and unforgettable domain expansion set pieces.

watch.title: Cowboy Bebop
watch.creator: Shinichirō Watanabe
watch.note: The cool melancholic king of space westerns. Yoko Kanno and The Seatbelts delivering timeless jazz and blues.

watch.title: Evangelion
watch.creator: Hideaki Anno
watch.note: Groundbreaking psychological deconstruction of the mecha genre. Existential dread and introspective vulnerability.

watch.title: Vinland Saga
watch.creator: Makoto Yukimura
watch.note: A profound journey from violent revenge to peaceful redemption. 'I have no enemies' is one of anime’s greatest arcs.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.note: A masterclass on compound improvements. The cue-craving-response-reward loop transformed how I approach daily software engineering.

books.title: Everyday Things
books.author: Don Norman
books.note: Affordances, signifiers, and feedback. Made me realize that if a user struggles with an interface, it is the design at fault, never the user.

books.title: Zero to One
books.author: Peter Thiel
books.note: Vertical progress from 0 to 1 versus horizontal progress from 1 to n. Contrarian thinking that fundamentally reshaped how I think about creating technology.

books.title: Steal Like an Artist
books.author: Austin Kleon
books.note: Nothing is completely original. Collect good ideas, remix, transform, and build your own creative lineage.

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.note: Rules for focused success in a distracted world. The superpower of eliminating noise and producing high cognitive output.

books.title: Thinking, Fast & Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.note: System 1 intuition versus System 2 deliberation. An eye-opening journey into heuristics, cognitive biases, and human judgment.

books.title: Refactoring UI
books.author: Adam Wathan & Steve Schoger
books.note: The ultimate tactical guide to designing modern web applications from an engineer's perspective. Hierarchy, spacing, and micro-details.

books.title: Show Your Work!
books.author: Austin Kleon
books.note: Generosity beats genius. Share your process, prototypes, and works-in-progress, not just the polished end product.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.note: A poignant and haunting examination of artificial intelligence, empathy, loneliness, and what it truly means to love.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
books.note: Timeless craftsmanship: DRY, orthogonality, stone soup, and taking responsibility for your code.

books.title: Creative Selection
books.author: Ken Kocienda
books.note: Inside Apple’s design process during the golden age of Steve Jobs. Demos, taste, iteration, and decisive product taste.

books.title: Sapiens
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.note: A brief history of humankind through shared fictions, money, empire, and our unstoppable technological evolution.
